data.name: Anvesh
data.long_meaning: Anvesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anu' meaning 'towards' and 'vidh' meaning 'knowledge'. It signifies a person who is always eager to gain knowledge and is intellectually curious.

vedic_reference.note: Anveshana (अन्वेषन) is the Sanskrit term for inquiry, search, investigation, or exploration. It's a process of seeking knowledge or understanding. This name is derived from the root Anu-Vesh (अनु-वेष), meaning 'searching again' or 'inquiring further'.

The pursuit of knowledge is considered a noble endeavor and is encouraged from a young age. The name Anvesh may also signify an individual's thirst for knowledge and their dedication to learning and growing.

The name represents the inner drive to seek wisdom and understanding, not just of the world around us, but also of ourselves and our place in the universe. It may also be seen as a reminder to always be open to new ideas and experiences, and to approach life with curiosity and a desire to learn.
